invariants.rationale: If keepWithinStage is true, then getStage() has been checked to be non-null, otherwise the method returns early.
If keepWithinStage is true, and getStage() is non-null, then getStage().getCamera() cannot cause a NullPointerException because otherwise the method would have returned.
If keepWithinStage is true, then getStage() is non-null and stage dimensions have been accessed.
